question_or_target: Does the runner route apostrophe-bearing content (commit messages, PR bodies, prompts) through a FILE rather than inlining it? PASS requires a static scan finding zero inline prose call sites, and a live case with apostrophes succeeding.

Static scan of tools/ plus runner.py, consumers.py, and tools/lib/codex-invocation.mjs found zero inline prose construction sites.
